create.name: Anandamai Charlyn Reihman
create.bio:
Anandamai Charlyn Reihman is a Kripalu yoga teacher who has spent years studying the life and sayings of Swami Kripalu, the Indian master whose name the Kripalu Center carries. She trained to the 500-hour level at Kripalu and added yoga therapy studies at the YogaLife Institute, alongside a public health master's from Drexel and a long first career in workplace health and safety. For more than a decade she sat on the board of the Kripalvananda Yoga Institute, which looks after Muktidham, the Pennsylvania retreat where Swami Kripalu lived while in America, and she still leads retreats there.

Her 2021 book, Walking the Path of Love, sets her own story beside Swami Kripalu's teaching tales across twelve chapters on themes such as truth, service and compassion, each closing with small exercises she calls love experiments. She also hosts a podcast of the same name, talking with senior teachers from the lineage. Charlyn lives on her family's farm in Green Lane, Pennsylvania, where she runs a small studio for classes and teacher gatherings, and she teaches gentle yoga, mudra and breath practices online and in weekend programmes at Kripalu.

books.title: Walking the Path of Love: Connecting to the Kripalu Lineage and the Core Teachings of Swami Kripalu
books.author: Anandamai Charlyn Reihman
books.description: Published by Balboa Press in 2021, this book pairs episodes from the author's life with stories told by Swami Kripalu. Its twelve chapters each take one theme, such as truth or self-observation, and end with practices readers or yoga teachers can try.

courses.title: Sacred Pause: A Weekend of Rest, Renewal, and Receiving for Caregivers
courses.description: A residential weekend at Kripalu for people who spend their days looking after others, co-led with Cindy Yaple. Gentle yoga, breathing, self-massage, meditation and rest are used to help each person slow down and leave with a simple self-care plan. It belongs to her Walking the Path of Love series on Swami Kripalu's teaching.

free_resources.title: Walking the Path of Love Podcast
free_resources.description: Her free podcast, also posted on YouTube, in which she talks with guests from the Kripalu lineage and beyond about how they live their practice. Episodes run about forty minutes to an hour.
